## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`...)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass from the repository root
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes if the UI changed
- [ ] `npm run classifier:lint` and `npm run classifier:test` pass if `ai-classifier/` changed
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for new behaviour
- [ ] Docs were updated if behaviour, endpoints or environment variables changed
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for visible UI changes
